title: Sendbox Shipping API For eCommerce businesses
body_markdown:
### Sendbox Shipping API For eCommerce Businesses


We understand the amount of work that is put into creating a product while also delivering a great experience to customers — all to make customers happy.


And when it comes to shipping, you may find yourself getting worried about leaving the fulfilment of your deliveries to a stranger. With Sendbox shipping API, you do not have to worry anymore about this hurdle.


Sendbox’s shipping API is the most adaptable shipping solution in the ecosystem. Our API interface makes it effortless for you as a developer or an operator to get Sendbox delivery up and running as speedily as possible.


This API has a full scale of features to make shipping easy and you can:


- Seamlessly get shipping rates
- Create new local and international shipments
- Easily track both local and international shipments


We have also provided a documentation which includes a developer guide that explains how to plug and code Sendbox functionality into your existing products or e-commerce website.


Integrate Sendbox into your products and gain access to the most adaptable shipping solution.[View our documentation](https://docs.sendbox.co/) to learn more and begin the process.
